### Stimulated Monocytes RNA Editing 

### Pipeline Results

* min_coverage: 3 (32 Donors)
* min_edit_rate: 0.01 
* site_missingness: 0.10 
* sample_missingness: 0.10 
* Post-pipeline filter on Editing rate : filter(Mean > 0.1) for each site

### PCA {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

```{r stim_9,echo= TRUE, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
res<-function(df_in, index){
  df_in<-df_in%>%dplyr::filter(grepl(index, Editing_Index))
  df_in<-df_in%>%dplyr::select(-c(ESid, Editing_Index, Mean))
  index_res<-as.data.frame(t(df_in))
  index_res<-index_res[-1,]
  index_res<-index_res[,apply(index_res, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) !=0]
  index_res<-mutate_all(index_res, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  index_res<-index_res[order(row.names(index_res)), ]
  index_res
}

pca<-function(index_res){
  index_pca<-prcomp(index_res, scale.=TRUE, center=TRUE)
  index_pca<-index_pca$x[,1:10]
  index_pca<-tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(index_pca),'sample')
  index_pca
}
```

```{r stim_12,echo= TRUE, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
load("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/RData/pca.RData")

pc_matrix<-function(index_pca_in){
  index_pca<-index_pca_in%>%tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")
  index_index_pca<-index_pca[,1:5]
  for (x in 1:n_var){
    for(y in 1:5){
      matrix_rsquared[x,y]<-summary(lm(unlist(index_index_pca[,y])~
                                         as.matrix(meta_select[,covariates[x]])))$adj.r.squared}
    }
  matrix_rsquared
  }

```

```{r stim_13a,echo= FALSE, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
############################ PCA PLOT ##########################################
pc_heatmap<-function( index_pca_in, plot_title ){
  index_pca<-index_pca_in%>%tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")
  index_index_pca<-index_pca[,1:5]
  index_pc_matrix<-pc_matrix(index_pca_in)
  rownames(index_pc_matrix)<-covariates
  colnames(index_pc_matrix)<-colnames(index_index_pca)
  range<-max(abs(index_pc_matrix))
  
  pc_heatmap<-pheatmap(index_pc_matrix,
                       labels_col = colnames(index_pc_matrix),
                       display_numbers = FALSE,number_color = "white", 
                       breaks = seq(-range, range,length.out =100),
                       fontsize = 8, color = hcl.colors(80,"BrBg"),
                       cluster_rows=F,cluster_cols=F, legend=TRUE, 
                       main =plot_title,fontface = "plain", border_color = "black")
  pc_heatmap
}

ct_heatmap<-pc_heatmap(ct_pca, "C:T Editing Index PCA 5")
ag_heatmap<-pc_heatmap(ag_pca, "A:G Editing Index PCA 5")
ct_plot<-as.ggplot(ct_heatmap, scale=1)
ag_plot<-as.ggplot(ag_heatmap, scale=1)
```

### Variance Partition {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

```{r vp_1, echo= TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
res_norm<-function(index_res){
  res_norm<-log2(index_res + 0.001)
  res_norm<-as.data.frame(t(res_norm))
  res_norm <- res_norm[,match(colnames(res_norm),rownames(meta_select))]
  res_norm
  }

# no NA value in neither META nor RES generating normalized editing matrix 
ct_res_norm<-res_norm(ct_res)
ag_res_norm<-res_norm(ag_res)

# Final formula the same for both index
form<- ~  (1|Stimulation) + (1|Batch) + APOBEC2 + APOBEC3C +APOBEC3G+ADAR+PCT_INTRONIC_BASES+PCT_RIBOSOMAL_BASES 

filepath<-file.path("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/RData")
ct_varPart<- fitExtractVarPartModel(ct_res_norm, form,meta_select)
ag_varPart<- fitExtractVarPartModel(ag_res_norm, form,meta_select)
save(ct_varPart, ag_varPart, file = (file.path(filepath,"105_Stim_varPart.RData")))
```

```{r stim_13a,echo= FALSE, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
varPart_plot<-function(varPart_in, plot_title){
  text_size=7
  varPart<-sortCols(varPart_in)
  varPart_plot<-plotVarPart(varPart, label.angle=20)+
  labs(y = "", title = plot_title)+theme_classic()+
     theme(legend.title = element_text(size=text_size),
          legend.text = element_text(size=text_size),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_size-5,angle =20, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5),
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(-5,-5,-5,-5))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  varPart_plot
}
```

```{r pca_4, echo= FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
load("RData/pca.RData")

pca_12<-function(meta_in, pca_in){
  meta<-meta_in%>%column_to_rownames("Sample")
  pca_12<-pca_in%>%column_to_rownames("sample")%>%dplyr::select("PC1","PC2")
  pca_12<-merge(meta, pca_12, by =0)%>%
    column_to_rownames("Row.names")
  pca_12
}

inplot_size = 3
point_size=2

apobec2_pca_plot<-function(pca_in){
  ggplot(pca_in, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color= APOBEC2))+ 
    geom_point(aes(color= APOBEC2), alpha=0.9, width=1, size = 2)+
    theme_classic()+
    scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")+
     theme(legend.title = element_text(size=text_size),
          legend.text = element_text(size=text_size),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5),
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(-1,-1,-1,-1))+
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}



batch_pca_plot<-function(pca_in,legend_title){
  ggplot(pca_in, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color= Batch))+ 
    geom_point(aes(color= Batch), alpha=0.9, width=1, size = point_size)+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=text_size),
          legend.text = element_text(size=text_size),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5),
          legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
          legend.box.margin=margin(-1,-1,-1,-1))+
    theme(legend.position = "right")+
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=legend_size)))
}


fun_mean <- function(x){
  return(data.frame(y=round(mean(x),3),label=mean(round(x,3),na.rm=T)))}

qc_plot <- function(df_in, x_in, Sample_Cohort, y_in) {
  qc_plot <- ggplot(data = df_in, aes(x = x_in, y = y_in)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = Sample_Cohort), alpha = 0.7, width = 0.25, size = point_size) +
    scale_color_manual(values = batch_color) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = NA,outlier.shape=NA) +
    #stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", label.x.npc = "center", label.y.npc = "center") +
    labs(x = "", y = "Normalized TPM")+#, title = plot_title) +
    #stat_summary(aes(label = round(..y.., 3)),
    #  fun.data = fun_mean,geom = "text",
    #  size = inplot_size,vjust = 2) +
    theme_classic() + theme(
      legend.title = element_text(size = text_size,color="black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = text_size,color="black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size,color="black"),
      #axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_size,color='black'),
      #axis.text.x=element_blank(),
      #axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size,color="black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, hjust = 0.5,color="black"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(-3,-3,-3,-3))+
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size =4)))
   qc_plot}

```

```{r stim_6,echo= TRUE, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE,eval=TRUE}
inplot_size = 3.5
axis_size = 14
ticks_size =14
title_size = 15
point_size = 5
text_size = 14

fun_mean <- function(x){
  return(data.frame(y=round(mean(x),3),label=mean(round(x,3),na.rm=T)))}

bar_plot<-function(df_in, x_in, fill_in, nudge_y_in, plot_title){
  bar_plot<-ggplot(df_in, mapping = aes(x = x_in , fill = fill_in))+
    geom_bar(stat = 'count', nudge_y = nudge_y_in,show.legend = FALSE)+
   geom_text(aes(label = ..count..), nudge_y = nudge_y_in,stat = 'count', size = inplot_size)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = all_index_color)+
    labs(x = "", y = "Site Count", title = plot_title)+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+theme_bw()+
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size))+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size= ticks_size))+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = title_size-1,  hjust=0.5))
  bar_plot
}

box_plot<-function(df_in, x_in,y_in,fill_in, plot_title){
  box_plot<-ggplot(df_in,aes(x = x_in , y= y_in,fill = x_in))+
    geom_boxplot()+
    scale_fill_manual(values = stim_color)+
    stat_summary(fun.y=mean, colour="black", geom="point", 
               shape=20, size=point_size, show.legend=TRUE)+
    stat_summary(aes(label=round(..y..,3)),fun.data = fun_mean, geom="text", 
               size=inplot_size, face="blod",vjust=2)+
    labs(x = "", y = "Editing Rate", title = plot_title)+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+theme_bw()+
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size))+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size= ticks_size))+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = title_size-1, hjust=0.5))
  box_plot
}

anno_plot<-function(df_in, x_in,fill_in,fill_title, plot_title){
  anno_plot<-ggplot(df_in, mapping = aes(x = x_in))+
    geom_bar(aes(fill = fill_in, position ="fill"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=anno_palette)+
    labs(x = "", y = "Site Count",fill = fill_title)+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = 'bold', hjust=0.5))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+theme_bw()+
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size))+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size= ticks_size))
  anno_plot
}

```

```{r limma_2, echo= TRUE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
run_diff<-function(cohort_in,model_in,tsv_title){
  # Subsetting GENEIDs with TPM>1 
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){meta_in <-meta_ifng}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){meta_in <-meta_lps}
  
  meta_in<-meta_in%>%column_to_rownames("Sample")
  meta_in<-meta_in[ , order(names(meta_in))]
  
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){condition<-factor(meta_in$Stimulation,
                                            levels=c("Basal","IFNg"))}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){condition<-factor(meta_in$Stimulation,
                                           levels=c("Basal","LPS"))}
  batch<-as.factor(meta_in$Batch)
  sex<-as.factor(meta_in$Sex)
  age<-meta_in$Age
  apobec2<-meta_in$APOBEC2
  apobec3d<-meta_in$APOBEC3D
  apobec3c<-meta_in$APOBEC3C
  adar<-meta_in$ADAR
  ribosom<-meta_in$PCT_RIBOSOMAL_BASES
  
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){editing_in<-ifng_ed}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){editing_in<-lps_ed}
  
  if(model_in == "model_1"){model<-
    model.matrix(~ condition+batch+sex+age+ribosom)}
  if(model_in == "model_2"){model<-
    model.matrix(~ condition+batch+sex+age+ribosom+apobec3c+apobec3d+apobec2+adar)}
  
  fit<-lmFit(editing_in, model)
  fitDupCor<-eBayes(fit)
  DE_sites<-topTable(fitDupCor, sort.by ="p",n = Inf, coef = 2)
  DE_sites$ESid<-rownames(DE_sites)
  
  DE_sites <- DE_sites[,c("ESid", names(DE_sites)[1:6])]
  DE_sites[c('chr','num','Editing_Index')]<-str_split_fixed(DE_sites$ESid, ":",3)
  DE_sites<-subset(DE_sites, select = -c(chr,num))
  DE_sites$Editing_Index[DE_sites$Editing_Index == "T:C"] <- "A:G"
  DE_sites$Editing_Index[DE_sites$Editing_Index == "G:A"] <- "C:T"
  
  DE_sites<-DE_sites%>%dplyr::mutate(DE_Index = case_when(
  adj.P.Val < 0.05 & Editing_Index == "A:G" ~ "A:G_DE", 
  adj.P.Val < 0.05 & Editing_Index == "C:T" ~ "C:T_DE",
  adj.P.Val > 0.05 & Editing_Index == "A:G" ~ "Non_DE",
  adj.P.Val > 0.05 & Editing_Index == "C:T" ~ "Non_DE"
  ))
  
  DE_sites_name<-merge(DE_sites, anno_gene_name, by = "ESid")
  
  filepath<-file.path("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/Toptable/Editing_Differential")
  write.table(DE_sites_name, file = file.path(filepath,tsv_title), row.names = F, 
              sep = "\t", quote = F)
}

run_diff("LPS", "model_1","LPS_1_Toptable.tsv")
run_diff("LPS", "model_2","LPS_2_Toptable.tsv")
run_diff("IFNg", "model_1","IFNg_1_Toptable.tsv")
run_diff("IFNg", "model_2","IFNg_2_Toptable.tsv")
```

```{r limma_3, echo= FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
inplot_size = 2
axis_size = 10
ticks_size =10
title_size = 10
point_size = 2
text_size = 10

vol_plot<-function(table_in, plot_title){
  vol_plot<- ggplot(table_in, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(P.Value),col = DE_Index))+ 
    geom_point(size =point_size-0.5, alpha=0.7)+
    scale_color_manual(values = index_color)+
    labs(x = "logFC", y = "log10(P.Value)",title=plot_title)+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color = "grey")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.key.height= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=9),
          legend.text = element_text(size=9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = axis_size),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size=(title_size-4), face="bold", hjust=0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  vol_plot
}

anno_plot<-function(df_in, x_in,fill_in,fill_title,plot_title){
  anno_plot<-ggplot(df_in, mapping = aes(x = x_in))+
    geom_bar(aes(fill = fill_in, position ="fill"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=anno_palette)+
    labs(x = "", y = "Site Count", fill = fill_title, title=plot_title)+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.key.height= unit(0.65, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width= unit(0.5, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=8),
          legend.text = element_text(size=8),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          axis.text = element_text(size= ticks_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, hjust=0.5))
  anno_plot
}

overlap_logfc_plot <- function(comp_in) {
  overlap_comp_plot <- ggplot(comp_in, aes(x = logFC_IFNg, y = logFC_LPS, col = DE_Index)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = index_color)+
    stat_cor() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +  
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0), col = "grey") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0), col = "grey") +
    labs(x = "logFC: IFNg", y = "logFC: LPS") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.key.height = unit(0.7, 'cm'),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.7, 'cm'),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = axis_size),
      axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = title_size, hjust = 0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))

  overlap_comp_plot
}
```

```{r diff_1, echo= TRUE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
run_diff<-function(cohort_in, toptable_title){
  # Subsetting GENEIDs with TPM>1 
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){meta_in <-meta_ifng}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){meta_in <-meta_lps}
  
  meta_in<-meta_in%>%column_to_rownames("Sample")
  meta_in<-meta_in[ , order(names(meta_in))]
  
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){condition<-factor(meta_in$Stimulation, levels=c("Basal","IFNg"))}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){condition<-factor(meta_in$Stimulation, levels=c("Basal","LPS"))}
  
  batch<-factor(meta_in$Batch, levels=c("Batch_1","Batch_2"))
  disease<-as.factor(meta_in$Disease)
  sex<-as.factor(meta_in$Sex)
  age<-meta_in$Age
  
  model_in<-model.matrix(~ condition+batch+sex+age)
  
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){counts_in<-count_ifng}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){counts_in<-count_lps}
  
  counts_in_norm<-calcNormFactors(counts_in, method="TMM")
  dge<-DGEList(counts=counts_in, samples = meta_in, norm.factors= counts_in_norm)
  v <- voom(dge, design=model_in)
  
  vfit<-lmFit(v,model_in)
  efit<-eBayes(vfit)
  
  message("Generating Toptable")
  DE_genes<-topTable(efit, sort.by = "p",n=Inf, coef = 2)
  DE_genes$GENEID<-rownames(DE_genes)  
  
  message("Adding Selective Cols")
  DE_genes$DE_Direction<-case_when(
    DE_genes$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & DE_genes$logFC > 1.00 ~"UP", 
    DE_genes$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & DE_genes$logFC < -1.00 ~"DOWN", 
    .default = "FALSE"
    )
  
  DE_genes <- DE_genes[,c("GENEID", names(DE_genes)[1:8])]
  
  message("Adding Gene Names")
  DE_genes_ID<-merge(DE_genes,gencode, by = "GENEID")
  # Deleting duplicated GENEID
  DE_genes_ID<-DE_genes_ID%>%distinct(GENEID, .keep_all=TRUE)
  DE_genes_ID<-DE_genes_ID%>%dplyr::select(-c(GENEID.1))
  filepath<-file.path("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/TopTable/Gene_Differential/")
  write_tsv(DE_genes_ID, file = file.path(filepath,toptable_title))
}

run_diff("IFNg","IFNg_DEG_Toptable.tsv")
run_diff("LPS","LPS_DEG_Toptable.tsv")
```

```{r diff_3, echo= TRUE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
vol_plot<-function(cohort_in, plot_title){
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){diff_in<-read_tsv("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/TopTable/Gene_Differential/LPS_DEG_Toptable.tsv")}
  if(cohort_in == "LPS"){threshold<-2.5}
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){diff_in<-read_tsv("/Users/hyominseo/Desktop/RAJ_RNA_Editing/Replication/TopTable/Gene_Differential/IFNg_DEG_Toptable.tsv")}
  if(cohort_in == "IFNg"){threshold<-2.5}
  
  diff_in_a<-diff_in%>%dplyr::filter(grepl("APOBEC|ADAR", GENENAME))%>%
    dplyr::select(c(GENENAME,GENEID, logFC, adj.P.Val, P.Value, DE_Direction))%>%
    dplyr::filter(abs(logFC)>1)%>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)%>%
    dplyr::filter(abs(logFC)>threshold)
  
  vol_plot<- ggplot(diff_in, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(P.Value),col = DE_Direction))+ 
    geom_point(size =point_size-0.5, alpha=0.7)+
    scale_color_manual(values = direction_color)+
    labs(x = "logFC", y = "log10(P.Value)")+
    labs(title=plot_title)+
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1,1), col ="#818589", linetype="longdash")+
    geom_point(data = diff_in_a, shape=19,  color="#36454F", size=point_size-0.5)+
    geom_label_repel(data = diff_in_a, aes(label = GENENAME),
                   box.padding   = 0, point.padding = 0, force = 100,
                  segment.size  = 0.3,segment.color = "#36454F",
                 angle = 180,point.size = point_size-1,color="#36454F",
                 nudge_x = 0.5,hjust =0,size = point_size-1.2)+theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.key.height= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=9),
          legend.text = element_text(size=9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = axis_size),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  vol_plot
}
```

```{r diff_6, echo= FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
compare_logfc<-function(comp_in,  plot_title){
  a_genes<-comp_in%>%dplyr::filter(grepl("APOBEC|ADAR|TREM|LIMK",GENENAME))

  overlap_logfc_plot<-
    ggplot(comp_in, aes(x=logFC_DEG, y=logFC_DES,col=DE_Index))+
    geom_point(size= point_size-0.5, alpha=0.5)+
    scale_color_manual(values = index_color)+
    geom_smooth(method="lm", level=0.98, se = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE)+
    stat_cor(method="pearson")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=c(0), col ="grey")+
      geom_hline(yintercept=c(0), col="grey")+
      labs(x = "logFC: DEG", y = "logFC: DES")+
      labs(title=plot_title)+
      geom_point(data = a_genes,shape=1,  color="#36454F", size=point_size-0.5)+
      geom_label_repel(data = a_genes, aes(label = GENENAME),
                     box.padding   = 0, point.padding = 0, force = 100,
                    segment.size  = 0.3,segment.color = "#36454F",
                   angle = 180,point.size = point_size-0.5,color="#36454F",
                   nudge_x = 0.8,hjust =0,size = point_size-0.5)+theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.key.height= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=9),
          legend.text = element_text(size=9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#36454F", size = axis_size),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
overlap_logfc_plot
}


mut_loc_plot<-function(cohort_in){

  deg_des_in$Location<-deg_des_in$`Gene Region`
  mutation<-deg_des_in%>%dplyr::filter(!grepl("unknown", Mutation))
  mutation$Mutation<-sub(" ", "\n", mutation$Mutation)  
  mutation$Mutation<-sub("nonsynonymous","NonSyn", mutation$Mutation)
  mutation$Mutation<-sub("synonymous","Syn", mutation$Mutation)

  a_gene_mutation<-mutation%>%dplyr::filter(grepl("APOBEC|ADAR|TREM|LIMK2",GENENAME))

  ggplot(mutation, aes(x=logFC_DEG, y=logFC_DES,col=Mutation, shape=DE_Index))+
  geom_point(size=point_size, alpha=0.8)+

          legend.text = element_text(size=9),

          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size, hjust=0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))
            
  loc_plot<-
    ggplot(deg_des_in, aes(x=logFC_DEG, y=logFC_DES,col=Location, shape=DE_Index))+
    geom_point(size=point_size, alpha=0.8)+
    scale_color_manual(values=anno_palette)+
      geom_vline(xintercept=c(0), col ="grey")+geom_hline(yintercept=c(0), col="grey")+
      labs(x = "logFC: DEG", y = "logFC: DES", title = "Location")+
      geom_label_repel(data = a_gene_location, aes(label = GENENAME),
                     box.padding   = 0, point.padding = 0, force = 50,
                    segment.size  = 0.3,segment.color = "#36454F",
                   angle = 180,point.size = 2,color="#36454F",
                   nudge_x = 0.8,hjust =0,size = point_size-0.5)+
      geom_point(data=a_gene_location, size = point_size,  alpha=1, aes(shape=DE_Index, color=Location))+
    geom_label_repel(data = mutation, aes(label = Mutation),
                   box.padding   = 0, point.padding = 0, force = 50,
                  segment.size  = 0.3,segment.color = "#36454F",
                 angle = 180,point.size = 2,color="#36454F",

  #mut_loc_plots<-ggarrange(mut_plot, loc_plot, ncol=2)
```

```{r tpm_2, echo= FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

gene_tpm_editing<-function(comp_in, GENE, plot_title){
  gene_deg_des<-comp_in%>%dplyr::filter(grepl(GENE, GENENAME))
  
  gene_tpm_norm<-tpm%>%dplyr::filter(rownames(.) %in% gene_deg_des$GENEID)%>%
    pivot_longer(where(is.numeric), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Norm_TPM")
  
  gene_editing<-editing_type%>%dplyr::filter(ESid %in% gene_deg_des$ESid)%>%
    column_to_rownames("ESid")%>%
    pivot_longer(where(is.numeric), names_to ="Sample", values_to="Editing_Rate")
  
  gene_editing[c('Disease','num','Stimulation')]<-str_split_fixed(gene_editing$Sample, "-",3)
  
  gene_all<-merge(gene_tpm_norm, gene_editing, by ="Sample")
  
  all_plot<-
    ggplot(gene_all, aes(x=Norm_TPM, y=Editing_Rate, col=Stimulation, shape=Editing_Index))+
    geom_point(size=point_size, alpha=0.8) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = stim_color)+
    stat_cor(method="pearson")+
    labs(x = "Norm TPM", y = "RNA Editing Rate")+
    labs(title= plot_title)+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.key.height= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width= unit(0.75, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=9),
          legend.text = element_text(size=9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#36454F", size = axis_size),
          axis.title = element_text(size = axis_size),
          plot.title = element_text(size=title_size-1.5, hjust=0.5))+ 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=4)))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  all_plot
}
```
